legend: Gross appearance; note the polypoid component within the dilated main pancreatic duct.

legend: The tubules are typically well formed, with recognizable lumina of various sizes. The tumour cells contain minimal cytoplasm, and nuclei are atypical.
Intraductal tubulopapillary neoplasm is composed of multiple smooth-contoured, cellular nodules that exhibit a predominantly tubular architecture.
